title: On Caesar and God
english: Concerning Caesar and God. The Pharisees together with the Herodians test him about the census tax. He shows them the coin and says, “Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s” (Matthew 22:21). When we are tested by people who are looking for pretexts, we should not be completely silent, nor should we speak carelessly. Instead, we should answer with reverence, so that we cut off every pretext and secure salvation for them.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Origen is commenting on the passage where the Pharisees and Herodians test Jesus about the tribute to Caesar.

title: On the resurrection against the Sadducees
english: On the resurrection, against the Sadducees. “You are deceived, because you know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God; for in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage” (Matthew 22:29-30). This must be allegorized, as the Apostle does with the slave woman and the free woman (Galatians 4:22-31). Those who take the matters concerning marriages bodily are deceived, just like those who expect bodily foods after the resurrection. “God is not God of the dead but of the living; for all are alive to him” (Matthew 22:32). Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Origen is closing the commentary with the Sadducees' question about the resurrection, interpreting Jesus' answer spiritually.
